title: Seminar in Government and Politics; Power, Politics, and Data: A Hands-On Introduction to Political Science Data Analysis with R
description: Dive into the world of political data to uncover the stories behind today's headlines. This course introduces students to the essentials of political data analysis, using R to explore and visualize trends in real-world political events. From election outcomes to social movements, you'll learn how data shapes our understanding of politics and gain hands-on experience working with the tools professionals use. Designed for both political science enthusiasts and those new to the field, this course requires no prior experiencejust a keen interest in how data informs the world around us.
